capabilities: Plan tasks in Table, Board, Timeline and Calendar views
Schedule repeating routines with per-day status and done state
Track time spent per task with a stopwatch
Display read-only events from iCal calendar feeds
Embed saved views into notes and sync data via a vault JSON file
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not only a timeline; it also provides Table, Board and Calendar layouts, databases, reminders and time tracking.
extras: Calendar events are read-only; Google OAuth sign-in and event creation are not built yet. Some drag interactions are desktop-only, and inline embedding in Live Preview is the least tested part. Reminders fire only while Obsidian is running and are per device.
intentEvidence: A Notion-style task and routine planner for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in task database with multiple layouts (table, board, timeline, calendar), per-day repeat tracking or time logging for planning routines.

relations.evidence: A Notion-style task and routine planner for Obsidian.
Read-only, through iCal feeds, so it needs no sign-in and works on mobile.

summary: Notion-style task and routine planner that shows one task set as Table, Board, Timeline and Calendar views, with repeating tasks, a stopwatch and saved view tabs.
